title: One key size, colours back on the keys
thisBuild: Every key is one size in real dp now: the dock, the synth, Steps and the tabs no longer grow with the screen, so a tablet no longer gets enormous dock keys.
Keys with an icon are filled with their tile colour from the icon boards: yellow transport, purple pages and synth, pink playing tools, teal sound shapes, slate tools.
Simple/Full and Poly/Mono/Acid have their icons back, in colour; every slider's icons stay in colour, not dimmed.
The synth's pad shows its kind's icon instead of repeating SCRATCH and the preset name.
Click and Count sit on the Play page by the bank numbers. A swipe's hit is taken back sooner. Scrolling a sheet over a pad no longer sets the pad off.
Chords and Repeat stay on the bottom bar; when folded the keys go a little narrower so all seven fit.
watch: Do the dock, Synth and Steps keys look like one family now, on the phone and the tablet?
Swipe off a drum pad: is the blip short enough?
limits: The top bar keeps its old sizes until you pick which of its keys go behind More.
